messages:
Caroline Wu: Hi everyone  first day! My laptop + dock arrived fine but the monitor tracking says 'delivered to front desk' and front desk says they never got it. Also when I plug into the dock the external monitor just shows a black screen (no "No Signal" message). Who should I ping for both the missing package and a quick hardware check? :wave:

Front Desk: Hey Caroline, we checked the log and no package scanned in for your name. Do you have the tracking number? We can check camera timestamps but it might take a bit.

Caroline Wu: Tracking is RDW-993801 per onboarding page. The tracker also shows a POD photo but I can't tell where it was left.

Logistics Bot: Update for RDW-993801: status=delivered, delivered_at=2026-04-07 08:14 PT, delivered_to=front_desk, proof_of_delivery=photo_available, courier_notes="left at front desk bench". Reply with "REVIEW_POD" to request the POD image, or "CLAIM_MISSING" to open an investigation.

Caroline Wu: REVIEW_POD please.

Logistics Bot: POD image: shows box on a bench in front lobby near planters. No clear sign of front desk staff. Opening camera review request and pinging Facilities.

People Ops - Lina: @Caroline sorry for the mess. Facilities can check the lobby and loading areas. Ramon from Facilities, can you take a look? If it's quicker, we can loan a spare monitor to you in the meantime.

Facilities - Ramon: On it. I'll check the lobby camera footage and physically sweep the reception and the loading dock. If we don't find it I'll bring a spare monitor to your desk in ~30 minutes.

IT - Ben: Hi Caroline  welcome! For the black screen: quick checklist before we swap hardware: 1) Verify the monitor's power LED is on. 2) Swap display cable between DP/HDMI ports on dock. 3) Try the monitor's on-screen input selector (sometimes it doesn't auto-switch). 4) If you have a spare USB-C cable, try direct connection to the laptop. If none of that works, Facilities/IT can swap the dock and monitor.

Caroline Wu: Power LED is on but dark screen. Tried DP->HDMI swap on the dock, no change. Tried monitor input selector, it's set to DisplayPort. No spare cable at the moment.

IT - Ben: Thanks. If the monitor shows power but no handshake, it's likely the dock's video mux or the cable. Ramon, if you bring a spare dock when you drop the monitor that will let us isolate quickly. Also Caroline, please open a ticket titled "New hire monitor/dock issue" so we capture asset tags and can RMA if needed.

Facilities - Ramon: Found the package on the lobby bench (POD matched). Front Desk missed it during morning rounds; I've moved it to reception and left a note. Bringing a ViewSonic spare and a spare dock to Caroline's desk in ~20 mins.

Caroline Wu: Thanks Ramon  heading to reception now to grab it. I'll test at the desk and report back.

Caroline Wu: Quick update  grabbed the monitor from reception and plugged it in. It powers on and shows the company logo for a second, then goes black. Plugging laptop directly into monitor via USB-C (bypassing dock) shows the external display fine. So looks like the dock is the problem. Opening ticket now (IT-44201).

IT - Ben: Perfect troubleshooting, thanks Caroline. We'll swap the dock and log the faulty unit for RMA. Leaving notes on the ticket and assigning to hardware team. :thumbsup:
